Abort control exits 73 after bounded start returns and before test resumes; tests rejection of already-dead child, not all post-liveness-check failure schedules.
No owned child survives any launched controlled case; full suites use unchanged fixture cleanup, not a whole-host process inventory.
Environment metadata records explicit overrides and inherited key names only, avoiding secret values. Raw stdout/stderr and UTC/monotonic command timings are retained.

No observer replacement, retrying launch, changed timeout, fixture sleep-to-pass, added skip or removed method.
